entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • GetClrValueUsingContainingEntity returns default value instead of null if containing ComplexType is null #39683

Closed

  • EF Core 11 regression: InvalidCastException projecting JSON complex types #39670
  • Translate Array.Exists to Queryable.Any #39527
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Translate TimeOnly.IsBetween on SQLite #39682
    community-contribution
  • Bump Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp and Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Workspaces #39681
    area-infrastructure
  • Fix enum.ToString() projection on SQL Server to use bounded string type mapping (#39667) #39676
    community-contribution
  • Avoid duplicate parameter counting for reused collection parameters (#39631) #39675
    community-contribution
  • Merge repeated single-row subqueries into one OUTER APPLY on SQL Server #39672
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39684
  • Bump @hono/node-server from 2.1.5 to 2.1.6 in /eng/harness-evaluation #39627
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump hono from 4.13.13 to 4.13.16 in /eng/harness-evaluation #39632
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39651
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39674
  • Bump FSharp.Core from 11.0.100 to 11.0.101 #39677
    area-infrastructure

    area-infrastructure
  • Bump Microsoft.AspNetCore.Identity.EntityFrameworkCore from 11.0.0-rc.1.26425.128 to 11.0.0 #39679
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump Microsoft.Azure.Cosmos from 3.63.4 to 3.64.0 #39680
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/11.0] Preserve owned replacements when original is requeried #39663
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0] Preserve generated values when replacing entries #39629
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0] Persist null complex properties on TPH siblings with shared columns #39662
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/11.0] Warn when collection properties are mapped as scalars #39664
    Servicing-approved
  • [release/10.0] Fix JSON complex property projections with identity resolution #39671
    Servicing-approved
  • Translate `Array.Exists` to `Queryable.Any` #39535
    community-contribution

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39642

    api-review, area-harness

    community-contribution

    community-contribution

  • Always use LF line endings in scaffolded code #39601

    community-contribution

  • Fix final GroupBy over queries with no identifier #39586

  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: Don't retry SQLITE_BUSY_SNAPSHOT #39587
